title: Cairnkeep context usage receipt v1
description: A privacy-minimal link from existing work evidence to a retrieved result. Receipts contain identifiers, digests, outcome labels and a timestamp; never retrieved content, queries, prompts or model output.

link_id.description: Equal to receipt_id for context usage links.

receipt_id.description: SHA-256 of canonical evidence_id, task_digest and result_digest fields. The outcome is deliberately excluded so a changed outcome is a conflict, not a second receipt.
